messages:
priya: Customer legal asked for a "custody evidence pack" for BYOK + Dedicated cross-region failover. They want: list of principals with rewrap/import rights, sample audit events, and retention guarantees. Need a concise package by EOD Friday.

diego: Quick summary: encrypted key blobs replicate between regions, unwrapped keys only live on isolated serving nodes/HSMs. Rewrap only happens when escrow/fallback is enabled.

sasha: Can we enumerate exactly which service accounts and roles have rewrap privileges? Need concrete names for auditor.

morgan: I'll pull RBAC history. We should export role->principal mappings and the timestamped grants. Auditor prefers CSV.

infra: Note: HSM vendor log format is binary; we translate to our canonical audit schema. That translation is done in /opt/log-shim/decoder. Give us 24h to produce vendor-native records + translated CSV.

kms-bot: Notice: recent manual rewrap recorded 2025-01-09T17:02:33Z by service-account:dedicated-escrow (audit-id: 20250109-7b9c).

priya: Good to include that specific event as an example. Also include a redacted JSON of the event.

diego: Example redacted event (can paste into packet): ```{ "evt_type":"KMS.Rewrap", "ts":"2025-01-09T17:02:33Z", "actor":"service-account:dedicated-escrow", "key_ref":"xxxxx-redacted", "region":"eu-central-1", "audit_id":"20250109-7b9c" }```

legal: Important: add statement about plaintext handling: "All cryptographic unwrapping and model inference on customer data occurs on isolated serving hosts within the customer's dedicated pool; key material is not exported in plaintext outside HSMs or serving memory." Have infra confirm wording.

infra: Confirmed. Also call out ephemeral operator tokens: break-glass flow uses time-limited creds (1h TTL) and 2-person approval recorded in the ticketing system.

priya: Retention question: customer asked for 7 years. Our hosted default is 90 days; for Dedicated/Private we can ship raw audit exports or set up log-archiving to customer S3 for longer retention. State options clearly.

sasha: I'll generate RBAC CSV (fields: time, principal, role, actor_who_changed). Will scrub emails. ETA 3h.

morgan: I'll draft the one-page custody boundaries diagram + bullets: replication, where blobs move, who can trigger rewrap, how we alert.

oncall: Add incident response steps: alerting (pager), auto-hold on write ops for affected tenant, preserve memory dumps off by default, evidence collection checklist. Link runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/byok-breach.

priya: Add a short vuln/triage blurb: HSM shim CVE-2025-0001 (low) — our configuration disables the affected API surface; patch scheduled next minor maintenance (2025-01-20). Link internal ticket: SEC-4321.

diego: For auditor transparency, include the extraction SQL we run against our audit warehouse (redact key ids): ```sql
-- extract kms/hsm rewrap/import/policy events last 36 months
SELECT ts, evt_type, actor, key_ref, region, audit_id FROM audit.kms_events
WHERE evt_type IN ('KMS.Rewrap','KMS.Import','KMS.PolicyChange')
AND ts >= now() - interval '36 months';
```

priya: Also include how we prove absence of plaintext: memory access controls, disk encryption, and that we run periodic binary-only attestation checks on serving hosts. Short statement + pointer to attestation doc.

legal: Please include confirmations that break-glass approvals are MFA enforced and logged. Auditor will ask for last 2 break-glass approvals.

sasha: I'll include a sampled audit CSV row for a break-glass approval after redaction.

infra: Reminder: cross-region blob copies are encrypted with customer-wrapped envelope keys; we never rewrap during copy. Rewrap only on explicit fallback or admin action. Add that sentence.

priya: Action items recap: Sasha -> RBAC CSV (3h). Infra -> vendor-native + translated KMS/HSM logs (24-48h). Morgan -> 1-page custody boundary + diagram (EOD Fri). Diego -> redact example audit JSON and SQL snippets (done). Legal -> review wording (ASAP). Oncall -> verify runbook links and add pager rota.

morgan: I'll compile deliverables into a single tarball and share to legal+auditor link when ready. Will post draft here for review before external send.

priya: Thanks folks. If anyone adds anything, drop it here.

sasha: CSV upload link (redacted): https://files.redwood/secure/exports/2025-01-09/byok-rbac.csv :white_check_mark:

oncall: One more: include a short line about retention encryption + checksum: we append SHA256 of each daily export to the ledger and store cross-region copies for integrity.

morgan: Great. Closing thread once tarball shared.
